notes: Zaoran Plateau's armour (forum t294, Ronson 2010 = Cryptic Souls zpquestarmour, 2009; the turn-in Raam's, Nov 2 2008): 18 glowing gems, two a piece, 45 class sets (15 classes x Akessan, Honor Guard, Zek) crafted by three lieutenants that Unmarked Headstones spawn. Item names but the server's own and Tunic of the Vilifier [SOE 2007-10-31] are ours, by the sets' labels; gem looks, stacks and rates ours.

npcs.name: Krognar
npcs.note: 'Krognar is Zek' (Raam): crafts the Zek armour from the glowing gems. Body: dab's Zek orc.

npcs.name: Merkym
npcs.note: 'Merkym is Honor Guard' (Raam): crafts the Honor Guard armour. Body: a human knight, ours.

npcs.name: Akessan Collector
npcs.note: 'the Akessan is called the Akessan Collector' (Raam): crafts the Akessan armour. Body: dab's Akessan.

triggers.name: Krognar

steps.text: Krognar of the Zek rises from among the headstones.

triggers.notes: An Unmarked Headstone's death may call Krognar (npcdeath, 4%): 'they despawn after several minutes' (Raam): 8, ours. One at a time (the lock); all three may stand at once.
